description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterResource, which implements a method to unregister a resource type in the Smarty templating engine. It includes a single method, unregisterResource, which removes a resource type from the Smarty registered resources list.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterResource
classes.description: A class providing a method to unregister resource types in Smarty templates.

methods.name: unregisterResource
methods.description: Unregisters a specified resource type from the Smarty registered resources.
